answer: Require each identity to unload verified work at a single-occupancy berth on a lagoon quay, where only one agent can hold a timed slot at once and each completed slot is carved into a public basalt ledger stone. A sybil operator can mint aliases freely, but every alias must queue for the same scarce berth-time, so fifty names earn no more in total than one. By the zenith of the cycle, the queue itself exposes splitting: gaps, doubled slots and impossible overlaps are visible to peers, who can refuse to attest them.
